integrity: The argument is self-contained up to finite-field cubic discriminant facts and a displayed substitution that can be checked directly. Computation is corroborative, not exhaustive over parameters.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime powers q congruent 3 modulo 8 excluding characteristic 3, with t squared equal to -2; only fiber counts, not explicit listing of each triple-fiber target.
title: The exact one-or-three fiber spectrum of a nonpermutation trinomial family
